title: Beautiful presentation; gorgeous cup; verse in broken English & slightly imperfect
text:
Beautiful presentation; gorgeous cup; verse in broken English & slightly imperfect. This is a gorgeous cat cup, saucer, and spoon set. The presentation is outstanding. It feels like quality. Unfortunately, there are some imperfections and the verse is not in good English.

This comes with a gift bag, a gift card, and a "Thank You" sticker to close the gift card. It also comes in an attractive well-padded box.

POSITIVES
- Presentation

- Sturdy china

- Very attractive

NEGATIVES
- My saucer has gold dots in spots; a cast off from the rim trim (see photo).

- Also my saucer has several faint gold smears on the edge (see photo).

- The verse on the plate is in broken English and says "One day I waked up and found myself surrounded by cats with curious faces, I called that feeling: happiness."  It should say woke up and there should either be a period or semicolon between "faces and I" and there should be no colon after the word feeling.

- The gift bag and card say "specially for you" which is okay as a sort of slang but I would have said "especially for you" instead.

In summary, this is beautiful at first glance and for that I give it 3 stars. However, for this to be giftable, the verse needs to be corrected to say:

"One day I woke up and found myself surrounded by cats with curious faces. I called that feeling happiness."

or

"One day I woke up and found myself surrounded by cats with curious faces; I called that feeling happiness."

The current price of $29.99 would have been competitively priced had this been in perfect condition. With the current imperfections this is not giftable. It is functional but most disappointing due to the broken English verse. In fact, I am a bit sorry I ordered this.
